high_level_description: This image is a meme featuring two characters from the movie "The Notebook." The top part of the image shows a man and a woman sitting close together inside a car, sharing a cigarette. The man is lighting the woman's cigarette with a lighter. The text overlay on this part reads, "can we start our friendship again?" The bottom part of the image shows the same man and woman, but this time the man is lighting his own cigarette while the woman looks at him with a concerned or surprised expression. The text overlay on this part reads, "this time i promise not to fall in love with you.
